name: Ibaraki

flag.description: A white disc on an indigo field, holding a blue spiral: a rose bud.
flag.symbolism: The rose is the prefectural flower, and the spiral stands for progress, creativity and growth.

hook: Ibaraki's white disc on blue holds a spiral rose bud; the name means "thorn castle", and roses have thorns.
trivia: Mito, the capital, is famous for nattō, fermented soybeans.
The present flag replaced an older rose design in 1991.
